carry.training.body: Preseason watch at {school}: {position} {playerName} made a noticeable jump in {area} during {period}. The next question is how that development translates when the games start.
Keep {school}'s {position} {playerName} on your radar. Progress in {area} stood out during {period}. It gives this staff another player to watch heading into the season.

carry.player-training.body: Put a lot into this offseason. Excited to get back out there with my guys at {school}
Different offseason, same goal. Appreciate everybody pushing me. Ready to get back to football with {school}

Appreciate the guys putting the work in beside me all offseason. Excited for this next season at {school}.

{school} is now in {newConference} after competing in {oldConference} last season. New opponents and a new conference race to follow this fall.

New league. Same {school}. Looking forward to our first season in {newConference}.

Conference context for {school}: {oldConference} last season, {newConference} this season. Keep the new alignment in mind as the conference race takes shape.

One departure to note as {school}'s new roster takes shape: {position} {playerName} is no longer with the program after {period}. No destination to report.

carry.departure-portal.body: After leaving {school} during {period}, {position} {playerName} is listed among the transfer-portal entrants. Another opportunity to find a fit; no destination has been confirmed.

carry.fan-training.body: Good to hear about {position} {playerName}. Please let this be the year that offseason progress shows up on Saturdays for {school}

carry.fan-departure.body: Wishing {position} {playerName} well. Roster turnover never feels simple when you've spent seasons cheering for the guy at {school}
